content.rationale: Success status is where the envelope meets its status-0 atom; the gate forces exits-0 to answer to the atom without re-deciding it. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
